description: Sends one real delivery of a saved webhook right now, with realistic demo lead data run through its actual field mapping and conditions, so the host sees it land at the receiving address. Side effect: a real HTTP request goes to the receiving system with demo data, so tell the host that a test entry may appear there; nothing on the campaign changes. Needs `session_id` and `webhook_id` from wi_list_webhooks. Afterwards wi_read_webhook_deliveries shows what a test or mirror address actually received.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

name: wi_test_webhook
